children: Noble Corp reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $728.76 million, down 8.7% year over year, while net loss widened to $117.02 million from $21.1 million. Fleet utilization increased to 67% from 61% a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Operating revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings (loss) per share”.
Floater revenue declined as dayrates and operating days fell. Suspensions in Brazil reduced revenue, but both affected rigs resumed work.
Noble sold five jackups to Borr and operated them under bareboat charters; higher utilization partly offset fewer operating days.
The company sold six rigs during the first nine months and recorded an impairment on Ocean Apex as part of continued fleet optimization.
Management remains encouraged by long-term ultra-deepwater demand while citing geopolitical, trade-policy and commodity-price volatility.
